question: Who won the Player of the Match award for RCB in the IPL 2025 final?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krunal Pandya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the grand finale of the **Indian Premier League (IPL) 2025**, **Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB)** secured their first-ever title, and **Krunal Pandya** emerged as the **Player of the Match**.
 
• **Krunal Pandya** delivered a stellar all-round performance, contributing significantly with both **bat and ball** to steer his team to victory in the high-stakes final.
 
• He played a crucial cameo in the middle order, scoring **38 runs** off just **19 balls**, which provided the necessary momentum to the **RCB** innings. ***Hence, the statement regarding his impact is correct.***
 
• With the ball, **Krunal Pandya** was exceptionally economical, picking up **3 vital wickets** while conceding only **24 runs** in his **4-over quota**. ***Hence, the statement regarding his bowling contribution is correct.***
 
• The **IPL 2025 Final** was held at the **Narendra Modi Stadium** in **Ahmedabad**, where **RCB** defeated their opponents to lift the trophy under the lights.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB):**

 
 
• After years of anticipation since the inaugural season in **2008**, **RCB** finally ended their trophy drought in **2025**.
 
• The team's success in **2025** was attributed to a balanced squad following the **Mega Auction** held in late **2024**.
 
 
 
• **Krunal Pandya's IPL Journey:**
 
 
• Before joining **RCB**, **Krunal Pandya** was a key player for **Mumbai Indians (MI)** and later captained the **Lucknow Super Giants (LSG)**.
 
• He is known for his **left-arm orthodox spin** and aggressive **left-handed batting**, making him a premier **all-rounder** in the **T20 format**.
 
 
 
• **Indian Premier League (IPL):**
 
 
• The **IPL** is a professional **Twenty20 cricket league** established by the **BCCI** in **2008**.
 
• The **2025 edition** featured **10 teams** competing in a round-robin and playoff format, remaining one of the most-watched sporting events globally.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Virat Kohli**: The legendary batsman and former captain continued his prolific run in **2025**, providing stable starts and winning the **Orange Cap** for the most runs in the season. ***Hence, statement 3 is related but he was not the Player of the Match in the final.***
 
• **Rajat Patidar**: Known for his ability to handle pressure, **Rajat Patidar** played a vital role throughout the **2025 playoffs**, including a half-century in the final. ***Hence, statement 4 is related to his overall contribution.***
 
• **Prasidh Krishna**: As a lead pacer for **RCB** in **2025**, he provided early breakthroughs in the powerplay, maintaining a high **strike rate** throughout the tournament. ***Hence, statement 1 is related to the bowling unit's success.***
 
• The **Player of the Match** award is typically given to the individual whose specific performance had the greatest single impact on the outcome of the game, which in the **IPL 2025 Final** was **Krunal Pandya**.
